title.id: Zenith 2.0 (1 Nov): Toko, pencarian lineup & data game terbaru
title.en: Zenith 2.0 (Nov 1): Shop, lineup search & latest game data

id: Dibangun ulang di atas data game terbaru (Tencent mengubah sebagian data tanpa ganti versi): Pulihkan Data kembali bisa menyimpan cadangan asli, dan semua 4 paket gambar ikut terpasang.
Pencarian lineup kini menerima nama Indonesia/Inggris (hero, taktisi, kata kunci), termasuk gabungan kata dan ketikan yang belum selesai.
Label di Toko dan penulis lineup resmi ("-Rekomendasi resmi") ikut diterjemahkan; nama pemain tidak diubah.
Kamus Lingbao & lineup bertambah (pola baru, deskripsi lineup resmi, istilah nama lineup komunitas).
Tetap Mandarin: gambar nama taktisi di judul Lineup, label kesulitan, dan tugas mingguan Battle Pass (teks dari server).
en: Rebuilt on the latest game data (Tencent changed some data without a version bump): Restore Data can keep original backups again, and all 4 image packages are applied.
Lineup search now accepts English/Indonesian names (heroes, tacticians, keywords), including word combinations and unfinished typing.
Shop labels and the official lineup author ("-Official recommendation") are translated; player names are left untouched.
More Lingbao & lineup dictionary entries (new patterns, official lineup descriptions, community lineup name terms).
Still Chinese: the tactician name image in the Lineup header, the difficulty label, and Battle Pass weekly tasks (server text).
